correctness.rationale: For each residue, partition pairs by x-y=r+tm. Strict inequalities exclude all |t| branches except t=0,-1 from the two cheapest weights. Their second order statistic gives the exact four-branch second Apéry list; comparison at adjacent indices and a complete residue sum give g1 and n1. All boundaries 3≤m,2≤h<m are handled. Independent integer dynamic programming verified 3916 parameter pairs / 238876 residues / 24283898 states in actual embedded verify.py and checks.txt; finite evidence is corroboration, not proof.

value.rationale: This determines a motivated natural three-generator near-multiple family, not an arbitrary finite slice: every threshold for the second representation, the first generalized Frobenius number and its full genus for an infinite two-parameter range. The divisibility criterion h+1|m pinpoints a structurally surprising one-unit jump and supports further representation-level study. No downstream theorem is required for a useful exact natural invariant classification.
